purpose: Make retained-scope disappearance, receipt/current-state lineage drift, invalid incident-repair references, decision supersession defects, continuity loss, acceptance-class collapse and unproven public/equivalence handoff claims fail visibly in the trusted Main Steward integration path without creating a second authority.

lineage.outcome: Accepted and unfinished work cannot silently disappear across existing repository governance ledgers, and trusted integration fails closed on stale lineage, invalid repair authority, unproven supersession/equivalence, or false public/acceptance claims.

why_now: PR #266 merged the exact #247/#248 incident-repair closure as 6a0a453da9620247d3931aa5e81de82cd4786a46 and resulting main passed Steward Structure run 34009216653 plus Linux/Windows/macOS Governance run 34009216638 through full regression, consumer smoke and evidence. Parent incident #206 remains OPEN. Global reselection chose the trusted/base-owned Steward integrity gate ahead of the read-mostly #254 auditor and the known merged-product repairs because this validation-only gate protects the integration boundary every later repair must cross. Historical PR #256 head 8ef15881afa90ec15d522b22124964d16b081179 is stale, closed unmerged and retained only as reviewed semantic evidence; it grants no current merge authority.

implementation_contract.reuse: Read and reconcile existing requirements, completion graph, current_state, active_receipt, incidents, decisions, acceptance evidence, action-receipt, work-continuity, discovery-closure and continuity-acceptance authorities. Do not create a second candidate queue, scope ledger, current-state owner or Steward.
implementation_contract.retention: held_or_boundary must remain exactly represented by LATER-01; graph requirements must remain inside canonical scope; continuity/discovery contracts must preserve unfinished work and explicit dispositions.
implementation_contract.lineage: ACTIVE current_state and receipt must agree on node/increment and exact baseline; incident repair IDs must resolve to current open incident truth with receipt-bound repair authority.
implementation_contract.supersession: New supersession requires exact candidate equivalence evidence. If the explicitly supplied exact predecessor cannot be inspected, validation fails closed rather than skipping the comparison. Historical supersession without local proof is not silently upgraded into an equivalence claim.
implementation_contract.public_boundary: A receipt declaring a public handoff requirement must carry a durable handoff reference, and repository integration may not fabricate PUBLIC_VERIFIED.
implementation_contract.trust: This bootstrap candidate requires explicit steward-meta-governance-reopen because it introduces the checker/contract and changes the trusted Steward workflow. After integration, the trusted base Steward workflow executes the base copy of check_steward_integrity.py; future checker/contract mutations require the same explicit Main Steward meta-governance reopen signal.
